answer: To stop fake clusters, the network pays watchtowers a 50% bounty whenever two accounts share secret signing randomness across rounds. One honest agent locks 400 credits once from the coastal inlet to the muddy delta, while monitors scan signatures like matching banded onyx slabs to one quarry block. An attacker running 600 fakes must lock 240,000 credits and loses 100% of that deposit if even two signatures share a seed. This fails if an attacker buys 600 isolated hardware chips so no two accounts ever share randomness.
